messages.campaign_fixture.quest.promises.title: Campaign fixture: promises
messages.campaign_fixture.quest.promises.descript: Choose whether to promise a report, inspect the ledger, and return to the mentor.
messages.campaign_fixture.quest.promises.investig: Inspect the damaged ledger near the mentor.
campaign_fixture.quest.promises.offer.li: The shipment never reached us. See what the damaged ledger can tell you.
campaign_fixture.quest.promises.reminder: The damaged ledger is still near our village.
campaign_fixture.quest.promises.report.l: Your discovery is recorded. We can follow the trail from here.
If you inspect the ledger, will you promise to tell me what you find?
I promise to report what I learn.
I'll look, but I won't make a promise.
Then I'll wait for your report.
Fair enough. I would rather hear that now.
I read the ledger. The shipment reached the old watchtower.
I'm breaking my promise. I won't give you a report.
You followed through. I'll remember that.
You gave me your word. I won't rely on it next time.
messages.campaign_fixture.quest.promises.memory.k: You promised a report, and you brought one. That still matters to me.
messages.campaign_fixture.quest.promises.memory.b: I remember the promise you broke.
messages.campaign_fixture.quest.promises.memory.d: You never promised me a report. I haven't forgotten your honesty.
messages.campaign_fixture.quest.promises.trust.to: Could you trust me with another lead?
messages.campaign_fixture.quest.promises.trust.li: Yes. You kept your word when I needed it. I'll bring the next lead to you.
messages.campaign_fixture.quest.promises.companio: Then let's find the ledger together.
We did what we said we would.
Keeping a promise counts for something.
A later conversation opened through trust.
